review.scientific: Internal review of anatomy, airway functional boundaries, pneumocytes, surfactant models, barrier compartments, vascular routes and 60 question explanations. Checked numerical relationships and landmark evidence; corrected bronchial venous connection diagram routing.
review.editorial: Separate review of reading progression, original prose, heading structure, figure descriptions, answer clarity, misconception correction and exam approach, recall, revision comparison and mastery checklist; added accessible zoom and table headers.
review.deductions: One point each for limited primary-evidence verification, scope for further signposting in long sections, SVG pixel rendering not tested, reader interaction not browser-tested, and unavailable browser/live HTTP tests. No external peer review.
